name: NXUSD Cauldron LP-price accounting
summary: The Cauldron accepted a live reserve-derived LP valuation when checking solvency, allowing one borrower to withdraw 998,000 NXUSD against insufficient JLP collateral.

loss.notes: The sole successful loss receipt transfers exactly 998,000 NXUSD from DegenBox 0x0b1f9c2211f77ec3fa2719671c5646cf6e59b775 to the helper with no NXUSD inflow or return. The DegenBox archive balance falls by exactly that amount, from 60,793,507.532450031356773887 to 59,795,507.532450031356773887 NXUSD. DegenBox receives and retains 0.045330977931305070 USDC/WAVAX JLP collateral, exactly matching its archive increase; this borrower-supplied consideration is not another victim asset loss. The helper's NXUSD, JLP, USDC, USDC.e, WAVAX, and native balances all end at zero. Downstream conversions and the 371,406.644911-USDC transfer to the profit receiver dispose of already-counted NXUSD and are excluded. NXUSD is valued at par; this corrects the seed's attacker-profit-style 50,000 USD estimate to gross victim depletion.

ageReset.description: DegenBox CREATE2-created and initialized the 45-byte EIP-1167 clone in one transaction. Its runtime hardcodes the CauldronV2 master, so the clone creation is the immutable activation of that implementation for this market.

sources.note: Reviewed the loss receipt and call trace, every receipt transfer, DegenBox and helper archive balances, sender and helper transaction histories, the clone creation receipt and trace, the master deployment receipt, and historical clone and implementation runtimes. The anchor transfers exactly 998,000 NXUSD from DegenBox 0x0b1f9c2211f77ec3fa2719671c5646cf6e59b775 to helper 0x16b94c6358fe622241d055811d829281836e49d6, and the block 19613452-to-19613453 archive delta agrees exactly with no NXUSD return. DegenBox receives exactly 0.045330977931305070 JLP and has no USDC, USDC.e, WAVAX, or native balance change. The sender's nonces 83-90 are four helper-deployment and reverted-call pairs; nonces 91 and 92 create setup and loss-helper contracts; nonce 93 is the sole successful loss and the sender's final transaction. A linked receiver supplies 1 AVAX immediately before the loss, and the loss helper ends with zero NXUSD, JLP, USDC, USDC.e, WAVAX, and native balance. DegenBox CREATE2-creates and initializes clone 0xc0a7a7f141b6a5bce3ec1b81823c8afa456b6930 in transaction 0xfec980e2671ccc947bf063a5cb3ac41299eacf3729eec9a2d1f7d74b534ee9d7 at block 19560264 index 0, timestamp 1662373247. Its complete runtime is 0x363d3d373d3d3d363d73e767c6c3bf42f550a5a258a379713322b6c4c0605af43d82803e903d91602b57fd5bf3, which immutably selects master 0xe767c6c3bf42f550a5a258a379713322b6c4c060. The loss trace delegates both implicated calls to that master. The clone runtime is absent one block before creation and unchanged through the pre-incident block; the 17,855-byte master runtime hashes to 0x80bd0e1f355635d874233939b53a01e8d183ee2877455c15576ae15496e8493f at its own direct deployment, clone activation, and pre-incident state. The older master was deployed in transaction 0x41fc5f18b1041861af59a4918feadad4cd6424059106a5af595dfa07f093617c at block 14302648 index 2, timestamp 1651752634. The immutable clone activation is the later age reset, so code age is 1662492401 - 1662373247 = 119,154 seconds.
